subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
12. 
Based on the depreciation issues identified in the case, which of the following is the most 
appropriate audit conclusion? 
(a)  
Multiple issues exist including non-component depreciation, ignoring residual 
value and lack of disclosure of change in method  
(b)  
Only change in method requires verification 
(c)  
Depreciation is acceptable if total expense appears reasonable 
(d)  
Depreciation errors are immaterial due to long-term nature of assets
